title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves adjusting the values of each column (except the intercept) so that their mean becomes zero. This transformation can help in simplifying the interpretation of the coefficients in a linear regression model.

title: Exploring Full Column Rank
text: When a matrix has full column rank, it means that all its columns are linearly independent. This property is crucial for ensuring that the matrix is invertible, which is necessary for finding unique solutions in linear regression.
